metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code agents, skills and an OpenSpec-based workflow, split into packs you install per project.

plugins.name: devkit-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic dev workflow: research, plan, implement, review, ship, debug and test.

plugins.name: devkit-openspec
plugins.description: Runs the devkit flow on top of OpenSpec: the devkit and devkit-lite schemas (grill → plan → readiness → TDD → evidence → review) and hooks that keep product code closed until readiness is APPROVED and refuse a PR without an approved review and evidence, and flow-check, which reads each stage file's header and says which stage passed and which comes next, and `/devkit change`, which runs one change as a loop over the checker, with locks that keep it from stopping early or writing code, and `/devkit roadmap`, which runs the roadmap's ready changes, several at once, with `/devkit status`, and `/devkit project`, which defines a project or one slice of it in the devkit-project schema.

plugins.name: devkit-design
plugins.description: Greenfield design in four DDD phases: business discovery, domain model, architecture and implementation plan.

plugins.name: devkit-stack
plugins.description: Technology references: Postgres, Neon, React performance, Vitest, multi-tenant SaaS and threat modeling.

plugins.name: devkit-ai-engineering
plugins.description: Building with LLMs: evaluation, multi-agent patterns, agent tool and CLI design, context compression and skill vetting.

plugins.name: devkit-panel
plugins.description: Side pane in the Claude desktop app over the devkit checkers: the change this session conducts with its next step, phases, PR, delivery items and child sessions, the other changes in progress, and buttons that put the owner's next command in the prompt box. Read-only.

plugins.name: devkit-compozy
plugins.description: Ships the CompozyOS driver of the devkit flow: one agent per devkit role and three loops (a change, its review round and a roadmap), installed into any project by compozy-setup.
